records.de: Stimmt, haha. Aber inzwischen lese ich Romane, suche gezielt nach Essen und ändere sogar meine Reisepläne.

records.ko: 한 곡 들었다가 여행 일정까지 바뀐 거예요?
records.en: You listened to one song and ended up changing your whole itinerary?
records.de: Du hast ein Lied gehört und am Ende gleich deine Reise umgeplant?

records.ko: 그러니까요. 이제 한류라고 하면 음악만 떠오르진 않아요.
records.en: Exactly. Now when I think of Hallyu, music isn't the only thing that comes to mind.
records.de: Genau. Wenn ich heute an Hallyu denke, fällt mir nicht mehr nur Musik ein.

records.ko: 저도 그 연결을 콘텐츠에 보여 주고 싶어요. 대신 유행 하나를 한국 전체라고 말하진 않게요.
records.en: I want to show those connections in our content too—without treating one trend like it represents all of Korea.
records.de: Diese Verbindungen würde ich auch gern im Content zeigen – ohne so zu tun, als würde ein Trend ganz Korea repräsentieren.

records.ko: 이번 영상에서 전통 장신구를 현대 의상에 같이 쓰면 진짜 예쁠 것 같아요.
records.en: I think pairing traditional jewelry with modern clothes would look amazing in this video.
records.de: Ich glaube, traditioneller Schmuck zusammen mit moderner Kleidung würde in diesem Video richtig gut aussehen.

records.ko: 좋아요. 근데 보는 사람이 ‘원래 이렇게 입는구나’ 하면 우리 큰일이죠?
records.en: Yeah. But if viewers come away thinking, 'Oh, this is how people traditionally wore it,' we'd have a problem, right?
records.de: Ja. Aber wenn die Leute danach denken: 'Ach, so trägt man das traditionell', hätten wir ein Problem, oder?

records.ko: 맞아요 ㅋㅋ. 원래 쓰임은 따로 설명하고, 이 장면은 우리가 새로 연출했다고 표시해요.
records.en: Exactly haha. Let's explain the original use separately and label this scene as our own reinterpretation.
records.de: Genau, haha. Wir erklären die ursprüngliche Verwendung separat und kennzeichnen die Szene als unsere eigene Neuinterpretation.

records.ko: 그럼 촬영할 때도 전통 자료 장면이랑 재해석 장면 폴더부터 나눌게요.
records.en: Then when I shoot, I'll separate the folders for reference footage and reinterpretation footage from the start.
records.de: Dann trenne ich beim Dreh von Anfang an die Ordner für Referenzmaterial und die neu inszenierten Szenen.

records.ko: 좋아요. 예쁜 것도 좋은데 어디까지가 원래 맥락인지 보여 주는 게 더 중요해요.
records.en: Good. Looking nice matters, but showing what belongs to the original context matters more.
records.de: Gut. Schön aussehen ist wichtig, aber noch wichtiger ist zu zeigen, was zum ursprünglichen Kontext gehört.

records.ko: 네. 그래야 짧게 잘라도 둘이 섞여서 새 전통 하나 만드는 일은 없겠네요.
records.en: Right. Then even if we cut it short, we won't accidentally blend the two into some 'new tradition.'
records.de: Ja. Dann vermischen wir beides auch in einem kurzen Schnitt nicht so, dass plötzlich eine neue 'Tradition' entsteht.

records.ko: APEC 끝난 뒤에 경주 다시 찍으면 행사 때랑 분위기 완전 다르겠죠.
records.en: If we film Gyeongju again after APEC, the atmosphere will be totally different from during the event.
records.de: Wenn wir Gyeongju nach der APEC noch einmal drehen, wird die Stimmung ganz anders sein als während der Veranstaltung.

records.ko: 그럴 것 같아요. 행사 흔적도 궁금한데, 다시 평소처럼 사는 모습이 더 궁금해요.
records.en: I think so. I'm curious about the traces of the event, but I'm even more curious about the city going back to everyday life.
records.de: Denke ich auch. Die Spuren der Veranstaltung interessieren mich, aber noch mehr, wie die Stadt wieder in ihren Alltag zurückkehrt.

records.ko: 좋아요. 다만 ‘APEC 도시’랑 경주가 원래 가진 문화유산을 한 덩어리로 섞지만 말아요.
records.en: Good. Let's just not blend 'APEC city' and Gyeongju's existing cultural heritage into one thing.
records.de: Gut. Wir sollten nur die 'APEC-Stadt' und das kulturelle Erbe, das Gyeongju schon vorher hatte, nicht zu einem einzigen Bild vermischen.

records.ko: 네. 행사 자료는 따로 두고, 지금 촬영은 현재 도시 모습에 집중할게요.
records.en: Right. I'll keep the event material separate and focus the new shoot on what the city looks like now.
records.de: Ja. Das Veranstaltungsmaterial halte ich getrennt, und bei den neuen Aufnahmen konzentriere ich mich auf die Stadt, wie sie jetzt ist.

records.ko: 그리고 행사 때문에 안내나 길이 달라진 게 있으면 따로 확인하고요.
records.en: And if the event changed any signs or routes, let's verify that separately.
records.de: Und wenn sich wegen der Veranstaltung Beschilderung oder Wege geändert haben, prüfen wir das separat.

records.ko: 좋아요. 경주가 정상회의 배경화면으로만 남으면 너무 아깝잖아요.
records.en: Sounds good. It'd be a shame if Gyeongju were remembered only as a backdrop for a summit.
records.de: Gut. Es wäre schade, wenn Gyeongju am Ende nur als Kulisse für ein Gipfeltreffen hängen bliebe.

records.ko: 수진아, 나 다음 주에 경주 답사 가려고. APEC 이후에 도시 소개가 어떻게 달라졌는지도 좀 보고 오려고.
records.en: Sujin, I'm going to Gyeongju for fieldwork next week. I also want to see how the city has been presented differently since APEC.
records.de: Sujin, ich fahre nächste Woche für eine Feldrecherche nach Gyeongju. Ich will auch schauen, wie sich die Darstellung der Stadt seit der APEC verändert hat.

records.ko: 또 사진보다 메모를 더 많이 찍어 오는 거 아니야? ㅋㅋ
records.en: Are you going to come back with more notes than photos again? haha
records.de: Kommst du wieder mit mehr Notizen als Fotos zurück? haha

records.ko: 그럴 수도 있지 ㅋㅋ. 근데 행사 홍보 문구랑 원래 문화유산 설명은 따로 봐야 하잖아.
records.en: Could happen haha. But I need to separate the event's promotional wording from the original heritage explanations.
records.de: Kann passieren, haha. Aber Werbetexte zur Veranstaltung und die eigentlichen Erklärungen zum Kulturerbe muss ich getrennt betrachten.

records.ko: 그럼 행사 때문에 많이 소개된 장소랑 원래 유명했던 곳이 어떻게 다른지도 보면 재밌겠다.
records.en: Then it'd be interesting to compare the places that got a lot of attention because of the event with the places that were already well known.
records.de: Dann wäre es spannend zu vergleichen, welche Orte wegen der Veranstaltung besonders oft vorgestellt wurden und welche schon vorher bekannt waren.

records.ko: 응. 현장에서 느낀 건 메모로 남기고, 연대나 역사 사실은 자료로 다시 확인하려고.
records.en: Yeah. I'll write down what I feel on site as notes, and then re-check dates and historical facts against sources.
records.de: Ja. Was ich vor Ort empfinde, notiere ich als Eindruck. Jahreszahlen und historische Fakten prüfe ich später noch einmal anhand von Quellen.

records.ko: 역시 ㅋㅋ. 경주 가서도 감상보다 검증부터 하네.
records.en: Of course haha. You go to Gyeongju and still verify things before you let yourself have an impression.
records.de: Typisch, haha. Selbst in Gyeongju kommt bei dir erst die Prüfung und dann der Eindruck.

records.ko: 현아 씨, 내일 오후에 한강 갈까요?
records.en: Hyuna, want to go to the Han River tomorrow afternoon?
records.de: Hyuna, wollen wir morgen Nachmittag an den Han-Fluss?

records.ko: 내일도 많이 더워요. 오후 말고 아침에 가는 게 어때요?
records.en: It's going to be really hot again tomorrow. How about going in the morning instead?
records.de: Morgen wird es wieder sehr heiß. Wie wäre es stattdessen morgens?

records.ko: 좋아요. 그럼 아침에 걷고 점심부터는 실내로 도망가요.
records.en: Sure. Then we'll walk in the morning and escape indoors after lunch.
records.de: Gut. Dann gehen wir morgens spazieren und flüchten ab Mittag nach drinnen.

records.ko: 좋아요 ㅋㅋ. 물도 챙기고 오래 걷지는 말아요.
records.en: Sounds good haha. Let's bring water and not walk for too long.
records.de: Klingt gut, haha. Nehmen wir Wasser mit und laufen nicht zu lange.

records.ko: 그럼 카페랑 전시도 찾아볼게요. 더우면 바로 들어가고요.
records.en: Then I'll look up a café and an exhibition too. If it gets too hot, we can go straight inside.
records.de: Dann suche ich auch ein Café und eine Ausstellung raus. Wenn's zu heiß wird, gehen wir direkt rein.

records.ko: 좋아요. 이런 날은 장소보다 시간을 바꾸는 게 제일 편해요.
records.en: Perfect. On days like this, changing the time is easier than changing the place.
records.de: Perfekt. An solchen Tagen ist es am einfachsten, die Uhrzeit statt den Ort zu ändern.

records.ko: 아빠, 근데 요새 우리 에어컨 맨날 켜는데 전기요금 엄청 나오겠지?
records.en: Dad, we've had the AC on every day lately. The electricity bill's going to be huge, right?
records.de: Papa, wir haben die Klimaanlage in letzter Zeit jeden Tag an. Die Stromrechnung wird bestimmt riesig, oder?

records.ko: 그렇지, 아무래도. 근데 요금보다 같은 회로에 전기를 너무 많이 쓰면 과부하로 차단기가 내려갈 수도 있거든.
records.en: Probably, yeah. But more important than the bill: if we draw too much power on the same circuit, the breaker can trip from overload.
records.de: Wahrscheinlich schon. Aber wichtiger als die Rechnung ist: Wenn an demselben Stromkreis zu viel gleichzeitig läuft, kann wegen Überlastung die Sicherung rausfliegen.

records.ko: 아, 그렇긴 하지. 근데 아빠, 갑자기 전기 코드 쪽에서 이상한 냄새 나면 어떻게 해?
records.en: Right. But Dad, what do I do if I suddenly smell something weird near a power cord?
records.de: Stimmt. Aber Papa, was mache ich, wenn es plötzlich am Kabel komisch riecht?

records.ko: 어휴, 그러면 일단 전원부터 끄고 전기 코드나 콘센트는 절대 만지면 안 돼.
records.en: Then first turn the power off, and do not touch the cord or the outlet.
records.de: Dann zuerst den Strom ausschalten und auf keinen Fall Kabel oder Steckdose anfassen.

records.ko: 응, 알겠어요. 역시 우리 아빠 최고야 ㅎㅎ.
records.en: Okay, got it. My dad is the best haha.
records.de: Okay, verstanden. Mein Papa ist eben der Beste, haha.

records.ko: 그 말 들었으면 됐다. 대신 이상하면 바로 불러.
records.en: That's all I needed to hear. But if anything seems wrong, call me right away.
records.de: Das reicht mir schon. Aber wenn dir etwas komisch vorkommt, ruf mich sofort.

records.en: No, that's wrong.
records.de: Nein, das ist falsch.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.de: Mein Name ist Christian.

records.de: Wie alt bist du?

records.de: Aus welchem Land kommen Sie?

records.en: Cutting out a single sentence and removing it from context can reverse its original meaning.

records.en: In the morning, I asked my grandmother, “Did you sleep well?”
records.de: Am Morgen fragte ich meine Großmutter: „Hast du gut geschlafen?“
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 가려는데 반찬을 싸 주셔서 가방이 무거워졌어요.
records.en: As we left they packed side dishes, and the bag got heavy.
records.de: Beim Gehen packten sie Beilagen ein, und die Tasche wurde schwer.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 밀폐 용기가 세 개라 버스에서 조심했어요.
records.en: There were three airtight containers, so I was careful on the bus.
records.de: Drei Frischhaltedosen, im Bus ging ich vorsichtig.

records.ko: 김치 국물이 샐까 봐 봉지를 두 겹으로 했어요.
records.en: I used two bags in case the kimchi juice leaked.
records.de: Aus Angst vor Kimchi-Saft nahm ich zwei Tüten.

records.en: They even stuck a note on it saying to put it in the freezer.
records.de: Sie klebten sogar einen Zettel drauf: ab ins Gefrierfach.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 보자기로 싼 그릇이 미끄러워서 양손으로 들었어요.
records.en: The bowl wrapped in cloth kept slipping, so I held it with both hands.
records.de: Die in ein Tuch gewickelte Schüssel rutschte, also nahm ich sie in beide Hände.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.en: The plastic bag was thin, so I slid a book underneath.
records.de: Die Tüte war dünn, also legte ich ein Buch darunter.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 양손에 통이 있어서 엘리베이터 버튼을 팔꿈치로 눌렀어요.
records.en: With both hands full I pressed the elevator button with my elbow.
records.de: Mit beiden Händen voll drückte ich den Knopf mit dem Ellbogen.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 냉동 보관이라고 쓴 메모를 뚜껑에 붙였어요.
records.en: I stuck a freezer-storage note on the lid.
records.de: Ich klebte den Zettel Tiefkühllagerung auf den Deckel.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 집까지 국물 냄새를 들고 가서 현우가 창문을 열었어요.
records.en: I carried the broth smell all the way home, and Hyunwoo opened the window.
records.de: Bis nach Hause trug ich den Suppengeruch, und Hyunwoo öffnete das Fenster.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 가방이 무겁다고 하자 아버지가 차까지 들어 주셨어요.
records.en: When I said the bag is heavy, father carried it to the car.
records.de: Als ich sagte, die Tasche sei schwer, trug der Vater sie zum Auto.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 국물 샐까 봐 뚜껑을 두 번 확인했어요.
records.en: I checked the lid twice in case the broth leaked.
records.de: Aus Angst vor auslaufender Brühe prüfte ich den Deckel zweimal.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 반찬 봉투가 두 개라서 현우와 나눠 들었어요.
records.en: There were two side-dish bags, so Hyunwoo and I each carried one.
records.de: Es gab zwei Beilagenbeutel, also trugen Hyunwoo und ich je einen.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 고속버스 좌석이 창가라서 할머니께 사진을 보냈어요.
records.en: The express-bus seat was by the window, so I sent grandmother a photo.
records.de: Der Fernbusplatz war am Fenster, also schickte ich der Großmutter ein Foto.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.en: I bought walnut cakes at the rest stop, and we ate them together.
records.de: An der Raststätte kaufte ich Walnusskuchen, den wir zusammen aßen.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 명절 기차표는 금방 매진되니까 미리 예매했어요.
records.en: Holiday train tickets sell out quickly, so I booked mine early.
records.de: Zugtickets für die Feiertage sind schnell ausverkauft, deshalb habe ich früh gebucht.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 좌석 배정이 떨어져서 현우와 쪽지로 이야기했어요.
records.en: The seat assignment split us, so Hyunwoo and I passed notes.
records.de: Die Sitze lagen auseinander, also schrieben Hyunwoo und ich Zettel.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 기차를 타기 전에 큰 짐을 택배로 부쳤어요.
records.en: Before taking the train, I sent my large bag ahead by courier.
records.de: Vor der Zugfahrt schickte ich mein großes Gepäck per Paketdienst voraus.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 역에 도착해서 가족에게 도착 연락을 했어요.
records.en: When I arrived at the station, I let my family know.
records.de: Nach meiner Ankunft am Bahnhof gab ich meiner Familie Bescheid.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 친척 집이 언덕 위라 천천히 걸어갔어요.
records.en: The relatives’ house was up a hill, so I walked up slowly.
records.de: Das Haus der Verwandten lag auf einem Hügel, deshalb ging ich langsam hinauf.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 마을 버스 시간을 두 번 확인했어요.
records.en: I checked the village-bus times twice.
records.de: Ich prüfte die Zeiten des Dorfbusses zweimal.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 집 마당에 개가 있어서 멀리서 기다렸어요.
records.en: There was a dog in the yard, so I waited a little farther away.
records.de: Im Hof war ein Hund, deshalb wartete ich etwas weiter weg.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.en: I had some fruit as a late-night snack.
records.de: Als späten Imbiss aß ich etwas Obst.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 돌아가는 길에 남은 전을 조금 받았어요.
records.en: On the way back, I was given some leftover jeon.
records.de: Auf dem Rückweg bekam ich noch etwas übrig gebliebenes Jeon.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.en: After arriving in Seoul, I called to let them know.
records.de: Nach der Ankunft in Seoul rief ich an, um Bescheid zu geben.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 반말 전환은 동생이 먼저 하자고 했어요.
records.en: The younger sibling suggested the switch to casual speech first.
records.de: Den Wechsel ins Vertraute schlug das jüngere Geschwister zuerst vor.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.en: In front of the parents I promised to keep honorifics.
records.de: Vor den Eltern versprach ich, die Höflichkeit beizubehalten.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 말실수로 형이라고 불러서 현우 눈이 커졌어요.
records.en: I slipped and called him hyeong, and Hyunwoo's eyes went wide.
records.de: Aus Versehen sagte ich hyeong, und Hyunwoo riss die Augen auf.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 호칭 연습을 차에 타기 전에 세 번 했어요.
records.en: I practiced the address terms three times before the car ride.
records.de: Die Anrede übte ich dreimal vor der Autofahrt.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 편하게 말해요 하셔도 처음엔 존댓말이 나왔어요.
records.en: Even after they told me to speak comfortably, honorifics came out first.
records.de: Auch als sie sagten, ich solle locker sprechen, kam zuerst die Höflichkeitsform.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 아직 어색해요라고 하니 동생이 천천히 해 줬어요.
records.en: When I said it still feels awkward, the younger sibling slowed down.
records.de: Als ich sagte, es sei noch ungewohnt, wurde das Tempo langsamer.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 존댓말 버릇이 남아서 게임에서도 요를 붙였어요.
records.en: The honorific habit stuck, so I even tacked yo onto everything in the game.
records.de: Die Höflichkeitsgewohnheit blieb, also hängte ich sogar im Spiel ein yo an.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 나이 확인 전에는 이름을 부르지 않았어요.
records.en: I did not use a first name before checking ages.
records.de: Vor dem Altersabgleich benutzte ich keinen Vornamen.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 처음엔 서로 존댓말로 시작해 마음이 놓였어요.
records.en: Starting with mutual honorifics made me feel safer.
records.de: Am Anfang half gegenseitige Höflichkeit, ich war erleichtert.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.en: Hyunwoo helped me match the speech style with a look.
records.de: Hyunwoo half mit einem Blick, den Ton anzupassen.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 존댓말 실수를 사과하니 아버지가 괜찮다고 하셨어요.
records.en: When I apologized for the honorific mistake, father said it was fine.
records.de: Nach der Entschuldigung für den Höflichkeitsfehler sagte der Vater, es sei in Ordnung.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.en: We agreed to practice casual speech only in the parking lot.
records.de: Banmal übten wir nur auf dem Parkplatz.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 결혼 계획을 묻길래 아직 천천히 알아가는 중이라고 했어요.
records.en: Asked about marriage plans, I said we are still getting to know each other slowly.
records.de: Nach Heiratsplänen gefragt sagte ich, wir lernen uns noch in Ruhe kennen.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 아이를 가질 계획이 있냐는 질문에 아직 정하지 않았다고 답했어요.
records.en: When asked whether we planned to have children, I said we hadn't decided yet.
records.de: Auf die Frage, ob wir Kinder haben möchten, sagte ich, dass wir das noch nicht entschieden haben.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 월급 이야기가 나오자 구체적인 금액은 말하고 싶지 않다고 했어요.
records.en: When the conversation turned to salary, I said I didn't want to give a specific figure.
records.de: Als das Thema Gehalt aufkam, sagte ich, dass ich keine genaue Summe nennen möchte.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 종교 질문을 받았지만 개인적인 일이라며 답을 아꼈어요.
records.en: When asked about my religion, I said I preferred to keep it private.
records.de: Auf die Frage nach meiner Religion sagte ich, dass das für mich privat sei.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 언제 결혼해요는 농담처럼 들려도 답이 필요했어요.
records.en: When will you marry sounded like a joke but still needed an answer.
records.de: Wann heiratet ihr klang wie ein Scherz, brauchte aber eine Antwort.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 국적 문제는 서로의 선택을 먼저 듣고 이야기하기로 했어요.
records.en: We agreed to hear each other's wishes before discussing the citizenship question.
records.de: Wir beschlossen, erst die Wünsche aller Beteiligten anzuhören und dann über die Frage der Staatsangehörigkeit zu sprechen.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 결혼을 결정하는 데 부모 허락이 필요한지는 사람마다 생각이 달라요.
records.en: People differ on whether parents' approval matters when deciding to marry.
records.de: Ob man für eine Heirat die Zustimmung der Eltern braucht, sehen Menschen unterschiedlich.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 직접 거절 대신 돌려 말하기를 현우가 먼저 했어요.
records.en: Instead of a direct no, Hyunwoo spoke indirectly first.
records.de: Statt eines direkten Neins umschrieb Hyunwoo zuerst.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 화제 돌리기는 날씨보다 음식 칭찬이 안전했어요.
records.en: For changing the subject, praising the food was safer than the weather.
records.de: Zum Themenwechsel war ein Lob für das Essen sicherer als das Wetter.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 나이 농담은 웃고 넘기니 할머니가 좋아하셨어요.
records.en: Laughing off the age joke went over well with grandmother.
records.de: Den Altersscherz einfach wegzulächeln kam bei der Großmutter gut an.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 솔직한 선을 정하니 현우도 한결 편해졌어요.
records.en: Drawing an honest line took the pressure off Hyunwoo too.
records.de: Eine ehrliche Grenze zu ziehen nahm auch Hyunwoo den Druck.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: “다음에 말씀드릴게요”라고 하니 시간을 벌면서도 분위기를 해치지 않았어요.
records.en: Saying “I’ll tell you another time” bought me time without spoiling the mood.
records.de: Mit „Ich erzähle es Ihnen ein andermal“ gewann ich Zeit, ohne die Stimmung zu verderben.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 취업 비자 만료일을 먼저 말해 오해가 줄었어요.
records.en: Bringing up the work-visa expiry date first cleared up a lot.
records.de: Das Ablaufdatum des Arbeitsvisums zuerst zu nennen verringerte Missverständnisse.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 계약직이라고 하니 안정적이냐는 질문이 바로 나왔어요.
records.en: When I said fixed-term, the stability question came at once.
records.de: Als ich befristete Stelle sagte, kam sofort die Frage nach Stabilität.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.en: Because of remote work I brought the laptop even on the holiday.
records.de: Wegen Homeoffice nahm ich den Laptop auch an Feiertagen mit.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 이직 생각이 있냐고 묻기에 좋은 기회가 생기면 알아보겠다고 했어요.
records.en: When asked if I was thinking of changing jobs, I said I'd look around if a good opportunity came up.
records.de: Auf die Frage nach einem Jobwechsel sagte ich, dass ich mich bei einer guten Gelegenheit umsehen würde.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 체류 기간을 묻길래 내년까지 연장할 계획이라고 했어요.
records.en: Asked about the length of stay, I said I plan to extend through next year.
records.de: Nach der Aufenthaltsdauer gefragt sagte ich, ich plane eine Verlängerung bis nächstes Jahr.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 한국어 능력을 시험받는 기분은 회사보다 가족 식탁에서 더 컸어요.
records.en: The feeling that my Korean was being tested was stronger at the family table than at work.
records.de: Das Gefühl, mein Koreanisch werde geprüft, war am Familientisch stärker als im Büro.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 야근이 많다고 하니 건강부터 챙기라고 하셨어요.
records.en: When I mentioned all the overtime, they told me to look after my health first.
records.de: Als ich von vielen Überstunden erzählte, sollte ich zuerst auf meine Gesundheit achten.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 퇴사 계획은 없다고 하니 표정이 풀렸어요.
records.en: When I said I had no plan to leave the job, their faces eased.
records.de: Als ich keine Kündigung plante, entspannte sich das Gesicht.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 연봉 공개는 하지 않고 범위만 말했어요.
records.en: I did not disclose the salary and only named a range.
records.de: Statt einer Gehaltsoffenlegung nannte ich nur eine Spanne.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 직장 분위기를 묻길래 동료가 친절하다고 했어요.
records.en: Asked about the atmosphere at work, I said my colleagues are kind.
records.de: Nach dem Betriebsklima gefragt sagte ich, die Kolleginnen und Kollegen seien nett.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 통역 없이 직접 말할 문장 세 개만 준비해 갔어요.
records.en: I prepared just three sentences to say myself, without an interpreter.
records.de: Ich hatte nur drei Sätze vorbereitet, die ich ohne Dolmetscher selbst sagen wollte.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 새 직장에서 안정적으로 지내려면 근무 조건을 먼저 확인하고 싶어요.
records.en: To settle into the new job, I want to check the working conditions first.
records.de: Damit ich in der neuen Stelle auf Dauer gut zurechtkomme, möchte ich zuerst die Arbeitsbedingungen klären.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 통역을 맡기 전에 현우가 제 눈을 봤어요.
records.en: Before taking over the interpreting, Hyunwoo looked me in the eye.
records.de: Bevor Hyunwoo das Dolmetschen übernahm, sah er mir in die Augen.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 긴 이야기는 요약해서 전하니 핵심만 남았어요.
records.en: I summarized the long story as I passed it on, so only the key points remained.
records.de: Die lange Geschichte fasste ich beim Weitergeben zusammen, sodass nur das Wesentliche blieb.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 농담은 그대로 옮기면 분위기가 깨질 뻔했어요.
records.en: Rendering the joke word for word almost broke the mood.
records.de: Den Witz wörtlich zu übertragen hätte die Stimmung fast zerstört.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 뉘앙스가 사라질까 봐 현우가 손짓으로 멈췄어요.
records.en: Worried the nuance would get lost, Hyunwoo stopped me with a hand signal.
records.de: Aus Angst, die Nuance gehe verloren, stoppte Hyunwoo mich mit einer Handbewegung.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 통역할 때 상대의 질문을 빠뜨리지 않도록 메모했어요.
records.en: I took notes while interpreting so I wouldn't leave out any questions.
records.de: Beim Dolmetschen machte ich mir Notizen, damit ich keine Frage ausließ.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 제가 끼어들어 한 문장을 직접 말하니 박수를 쳤어요.
records.en: When I cut in and said one sentence myself, they clapped.
records.de: Als ich mich einmischte und einen Satz selbst sagte, klatschten sie.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 천천히 말해 주세요 하고 두 번 부탁하니 속도가 줄었어요.
records.en: After I asked twice for slower speech, the pace came down.
records.de: Nachdem ich zweimal um langsameres Sprechen gebeten hatte, wurde das Tempo ruhiger.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.en: I double-checked numbers and dates before passing them on.
records.de: Zahlen und Daten prüfte ich noch einmal, bevor ich sie weitergab.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.en: When I corrected the mistranslation, father actually thanked me.
records.de: Als ich die Falschübersetzung korrigierte, bedankte sich der Vater sogar.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 통역 중에도 눈치 보며 웃을 타이밍을 골랐어요.
records.en: While interpreting I read the room and chose when to laugh.
records.de: Beim Dolmetschen las ich die Lage und wählte den Moment zum Lachen.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 대충 하지 말라고 현우가 귓속말로 했어요.
records.en: Hyunwoo whispered to me not to do it so carelessly.
records.de: Hyunwoo flüsterte mir zu, ich solle das nicht so schludrig machen.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 쉬운 질문은 직접 대답하니 표정이 밝아졌어요.
records.en: When I answered the easy questions myself, their faces brightened.
records.de: Als ich die leichten Fragen selbst beantwortete, hellten sich die Gesichter auf.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 잔을 받을 때 두 손으로 하니 삼촌이 고개를 끄덕이셨어요.
records.en: I took the glass with both hands, and uncle nodded.
records.de: Ich nahm das Glas mit beiden Händen entgegen, und der Onkel nickte.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 잔을 따를 때 병목을 가리니 현우가 잘했다고 했어요.
records.en: Hyunwoo said I did well to cover the bottle neck while pouring.
records.de: Hyunwoo lobte mich, weil ich beim Einschenken den Flaschenhals verdeckte.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 우리가 결정할게요를 두 번 말하니 압박이 줄었어요.
records.en: Repeating “We’ll decide that ourselves” twice eased the pressure.
records.de: Als ich zweimal sagte: „Wir entscheiden das selbst“, ließ der Druck nach.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: '오늘은 여기까지'라고 말하고 나머지 이야기는 다음에 하기로 했어요.
records.en: I said, “That's enough for today,” and we agreed to discuss the rest another time.
records.de: Ich habe gesagt „Für heute reicht es“ und wir haben vereinbart, den Rest später zu besprechen.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 요청을 거절하면서도 관계를 지키고 싶어서 이유와 감사 인사를 함께 전했어요.
records.en: I wanted to decline the request while preserving the relationship, so I explained my reason and expressed my thanks.
records.de: Da ich die Bitte ablehnen und trotzdem die Beziehung erhalten wollte, habe ich meinen Grund erklärt und mich bedankt.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 공식 소개에서는 이름보다 관계를 먼저 말했어요.
records.en: In the formal introduction I named the relationship before the name.
records.de: In der formellen Vorstellung nannte ich zuerst die Beziehung, dann den Namen.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 자리 배치는 나이 순이라 제가 문을 가까운 쪽에 앉았어요.
records.en: We were seated by age, so I sat closer to the door.
records.de: Die Plätze waren nach Alter angeordnet, deshalb saß ich näher an der Tür.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 사진 공개 전에 얼굴이 나온 분들께 확인했어요.
records.en: Before posting the photo, I checked with everyone who could be identified in it.
records.de: Bevor wir das Foto veröffentlichten, bat ich alle erkennbaren Personen um ihr Einverständnis.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 호칭 공개는 집 안 말과 다르게 더 높였어요.
records.en: I used a more formal way of addressing them in public than I did at home.
records.de: Außer Haus wählte ich eine förmlichere Anrede als zu Hause.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 모임 지각을 사과할 때 변명보다 감사를 먼저 했어요.
records.en: When I apologized for being late to the gathering, I thanked them before explaining.
records.de: Als ich mich für meine Verspätung entschuldigte, bedankte ich mich zuerst, statt mich zu rechtfertigen.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 단체 인사는 큰 소리보다 고개가 중요했어요.
records.en: When greeting the group, the bow mattered more than how loudly I spoke.
records.de: Beim Gruß an die Gruppe kam es mehr auf die Verbeugung als auf die Lautstärke an.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 자리 양보를 하자 삼촌이 괜찮다고 손짓하셨어요.
records.en: When I offered my uncle my seat, he waved me off and said he was fine.
records.de: Als ich meinem Onkel meinen Platz anbot, winkte er ab und sagte, es sei schon in Ordnung.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 공개 질문 시간에는 짧게 답하고 개인적인 내용은 따로 이야기했어요.
records.en: During the public question period, I answered briefly and discussed personal details separately.
records.de: In der öffentlichen Fragerunde habe ich kurz geantwortet und persönliche Details später unter vier Augen besprochen.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 커플 호칭을 밖에서 낮추지 않기로 했어요.
records.en: We agreed to keep using respectful forms of address with each other in public.
records.de: Wir haben vereinbart, uns auch in der Öffentlichkeit weiterhin respektvoll anzureden.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 모임 장소가 너무 시끄러워서 소개를 미루기로 했어요.
records.en: It was too noisy at the gathering, so we decided to postpone the introductions.
records.de: Beim Treffen war es zu laut, deshalb beschlossen wir, die Vorstellungsrunde zu verschieben.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.en: Once I explained how we were connected, the timing for a handshake felt right.
records.de: Als ich zuerst erklärte, wie wir miteinander verbunden sind, ergab sich der passende Moment für den Handschlag.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 밖에서 예의를 지키니 집 안 실수는 잊히는 편이었어요.
records.en: When I kept good manners in public, people were more likely to overlook my small mistakes at home.
records.de: Wenn ich mich draußen an die Etikette hielt, sah man mir kleinere Fehler zu Hause eher nach.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 소설에서 '우리 며느리'라는 호칭은 환영의 뜻을 담으면서도 집안일에 대한 기대를 드러낸다.
records.en: In the novel, the phrase “our daughter-in-law” expresses acceptance while also conveying expectations about housework.
records.de: Im Roman drückt die Anrede „unsere Schwiegertochter“ Zugehörigkeit aus, vermittelt aber zugleich Erwartungen an die Hausarbeit.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 가족이 된 뒤에도 손님으로 두다 보니 중요한 결정에서 그 사람의 의견이 빠졌다.
records.en: Continuing to treat the person as a guest even after they joined the family left their views out of important decisions.
records.de: Weil die Person auch als Familienmitglied weiterhin wie ein Gast behandelt wurde, blieb ihre Meinung bei wichtigen Entscheidungen unberücksichtigt.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 이 글은 '우리 가족'이라는 소속 프레임이 누구를 포함하고 누구를 배제하는지 분석한다.
records.en: The text examines whom the framing of “our family” includes and whom it excludes.
records.de: Der Text untersucht, wen der Zugehörigkeitsrahmen „unsere Familie“ einschließt und wen er ausschließt.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 이 글에서 역할 언어는 '며느리니까 해야 한다'처럼 가족 구성원의 의무를 규정하는 표현을 뜻한다.
records.en: In this text, role-based language means expressions that assign duties to family members, such as “A daughter-in-law should do that.”
records.de: In diesem Text bezeichnet Rollensprache Formulierungen, die Familienmitgliedern Pflichten zuschreiben, etwa „Das gehört sich für eine Schwiegertochter“.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 토론에서는 혼인 여부를 전제하지 않는 포용적 호칭을 사용하자는 의견이 나왔다.
records.en: During the discussion, someone proposed using inclusive forms of address that do not assume a person's marital status.
records.de: In der Diskussion wurde vorgeschlagen, inklusive Anreden zu verwenden, die keinen bestimmten Familienstand voraussetzen.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 이 에세이는 이주민을 늘 '외부인'으로 부르는 표현에서 타자화의 문제를 찾는다.
records.en: The essay identifies othering in language that consistently labels migrants as “outsiders.”
records.de: Der Essay sieht ein Problem des Othering darin, Zugewanderte stets als „Außenstehende“ zu bezeichnen.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 소설의 가족 서사는 부모의 기억과 자녀의 경험이 충돌하는 장면을 중심으로 전개된다.
records.en: The novel's family narrative develops around scenes where the parents' memories clash with their children's experiences.
records.de: Die Familiengeschichte im Roman entfaltet sich vor allem in Szenen, in denen die Erinnerungen der Eltern mit den Erfahrungen der Kinder kollidieren.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 구술 기록을 분석할 때는 경험을 말한 사람과 해석의 주체가 다를 수 있음을 고려해야 한다.
records.en: When analyzing oral accounts, we need to consider that the person describing an experience may differ from the person interpreting it.
records.de: Bei der Analyse mündlicher Zeugnisse ist zu berücksichtigen, dass die erzählende und die deutende Person nicht dieselbe sein müssen.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 작가는 가족회의에서 누가 말할 수 있는지를 '말의 자리'라는 표현으로 설명한다.
records.en: The author uses the phrase “space to speak” to describe who gets to speak in family discussions.
records.de: Mit dem Ausdruck „Raum zum Sprechen“ beschreibt der Autor, wer sich in Familiengesprächen äußern darf.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 보고서는 가족의 '도움'으로 여겨지던 일을 돌봄 노동으로 다시 명명한다.
records.en: The report reframes work previously described as family “help” as care work.
records.de: Der Bericht benennt Tätigkeiten, die bisher als familiäre „Hilfe“ galten, neu als Sorgearbeit.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: '도와준다'는 표현에 담긴 프레임을 드러내면 누가 집안일의 책임자로 여겨지는지 보인다.
records.en: Examining the framing behind “helping” reveals who is assumed to be responsible for housework.
records.de: Wenn man den Deutungsrahmen hinter „helfen“ sichtbar macht, zeigt sich, wem die Verantwortung für die Hausarbeit zugeschrieben wird.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 소설의 주인공은 가족 안에서 자신의 자리를 재협상하다가 오랫동안 미뤄 온 갈등과 마주한다.
records.en: As the protagonist renegotiates their place in the family, they confront conflicts that have long been put off.
records.de: Als die Hauptfigur ihren Platz in der Familie neu aushandelt, stößt sie auf Konflikte, die lange aufgeschoben wurden.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 가족 행사를 준비할 때는 장보기와 일정 조율처럼 보이지 않는 일도 분담해야 한다.
records.en: When preparing a family event, invisible work such as shopping and coordinating schedules also needs to be shared.
records.de: Bei der Vorbereitung einer Familienfeier sollten auch unsichtbare Aufgaben wie Einkaufen und Terminabsprachen aufgeteilt werden.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 이 보고서는 명절 가사 노동의 성별 분업이 어떻게 유지되는지 인터뷰를 통해 살펴본다.
records.en: The report uses interviews to examine how the gendered division of domestic labor during holidays is maintained.
records.de: Der Bericht untersucht anhand von Interviews, wie die geschlechtliche Arbeitsteilung bei der Hausarbeit an Feiertagen fortbesteht.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 돌봄 부담이 한 사람에게 집중되면 유급 노동과 휴식에 쓸 수 있는 시간이 줄어들 수 있다.
records.en: When the burden of care falls on one person, it may leave them less time for paid work and rest.
records.de: Konzentriert sich die Sorgearbeit auf eine Person, kann ihr weniger Zeit für Erwerbsarbeit und Erholung bleiben.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 연구진은 준비와 정리 시간을 함께 기록해 가족 구성원별 기여의 가시성을 높였다.
records.en: The researchers recorded both preparation and cleanup time to make each family member's contribution more visible.
records.de: Das Forschungsteam erfasste sowohl Vorbereitungs- als auch Aufräumzeiten, um die Beiträge der einzelnen Familienmitglieder sichtbar zu machen.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 이 에세이는 전통의 선택을 다루며 어떤 관습을 이어 갈지 가족이 함께 논의해야 한다고 주장한다.
records.en: The essay discusses the choice of traditions and argues that families should decide together which customs to continue.
records.de: Der Essay befasst sich mit der Auswahl von Traditionen und argumentiert, dass Familien gemeinsam besprechen sollten, welche Bräuche sie weiterführen.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 돌봄 노동 인정은 감사 표현에 그치지 않고 휴식과 비용 분담으로 이어져야 한다.
records.en: Recognition of care work should go beyond expressions of thanks and include time to rest and shared costs.
records.de: Die Anerkennung von Sorgearbeit sollte über Dank hinausgehen und sich in Erholungszeiten und geteilten Kosten zeigen.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 명절 노동을 논하는 글은 일을 나누는 기준과 함께 휴식권의 문제도 제기한다.
records.en: The text on holiday labor raises the question of the right to rest alongside criteria for sharing tasks.
records.de: Der Text über Arbeit an Feiertagen thematisiert neben der Aufgabenverteilung auch das Recht auf Erholung.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 가사 노동의 분배 기준에는 나이뿐 아니라 건강 상태와 돌봄 책임도 반영해야 한다.
records.en: Criteria for distributing housework should take health and care responsibilities into account as well as age.
records.de: Bei der Verteilung der Hausarbeit sollten neben dem Alter auch der Gesundheitszustand und Sorgepflichten berücksichtigt werden.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 가족회의에서는 침묵의 동의를 당연하게 여기지 말고 각자의 의사를 직접 확인해야 한다.
records.en: In family discussions, silence should not automatically be taken as agreement; everyone's wishes should be checked explicitly.
records.de: In Familiengesprächen sollte Schweigen nicht selbstverständlich als Zustimmung gelten; die Beteiligten sollten ausdrücklich nach ihrer Meinung gefragt werden.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 돌봄 부담을 줄이려면 개인의 헌신에 기대는 구조를 바꾸어야 한다.
records.en: Reducing the burden of care requires changing structures that rely on individual self-sacrifice.
records.de: Um die Belastung durch Sorgearbeit zu verringern, müssen Strukturen verändert werden, die auf persönlicher Aufopferung beruhen.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 집안일에 든 시간을 기록하면 그동안 당연하게 여겼던 노동을 보이게 할 수 있다.
records.en: Recording time spent on housework can make visible the labor previously taken for granted.
records.de: Wer die für Hausarbeit aufgewendete Zeit erfasst, kann Arbeit sichtbar machen, die bisher als selbstverständlich galt.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 가족 행사에서 공평을 설계하려면 준비부터 정리까지 필요한 일을 함께 살펴야 한다.
records.en: Planning a family event fairly means considering all the work involved, from preparation to cleanup.
records.de: Um eine Familienfeier fair zu organisieren, sollten alle Aufgaben von der Vorbereitung bis zum Aufräumen gemeinsam betrachtet werden.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 명절 행사에 관한 의사결정권이 특정 가족 구성원에게 집중되는 과정을 인터뷰로 분석했다.
records.en: Interviews were used to analyze how decision-making power over holiday events becomes concentrated among particular family members.
records.de: Anhand von Interviews wurde untersucht, wie sich die Entscheidungsbefugnis über Feiertagsfeiern bei einzelnen Familienmitgliedern konzentriert.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 이 연구는 갈등을 드러내지 말라는 침묵 압력이 가족 내 협의를 제한할 수 있다고 설명한다.
records.en: The study explains how pressure to remain silent about conflicts can limit discussion within a family.
records.de: Die Studie erläutert, dass der Druck, Konflikte nicht anzusprechen, die Verständigung innerhalb einer Familie einschränken kann.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 회의록에는 당사자의 의견과 다른 사람이 대신 말한 대리 발화를 구분해 기록했다.
records.en: The minutes distinguished the affected person's own views from statements made by someone else on their behalf.
records.de: Im Protokoll wurden eigene Äußerungen der Betroffenen von Aussagen unterschieden, die andere stellvertretend für sie machten.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 체면을 지키려고 가족 모임 예산보다 많은 돈을 쓰자는 말이 나왔어요.
records.en: At the family gathering, someone suggested spending more than budgeted to save face.
records.de: Bei der Familienfeier schlug jemand vor, mehr als geplant auszugeben, um das Gesicht zu wahren.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 소설은 가족 앞에서 순응 연출을 하던 인물이 혼자 있을 때 드러내는 불만을 대비시킨다.
records.en: The novel contrasts a character's performance of compliance before the family with the resentment they reveal in private.
records.de: Der Roman stellt die inszenierte Fügsamkeit der Figur vor ihrer Familie ihrer Unzufriedenheit im privaten Moment gegenüber.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 권한의 출처를 나이나 혈연으로만 설명하면 다른 구성원의 참여를 제한할 수 있다.
records.en: Grounding authority solely in age or blood ties can restrict other members' participation.
records.de: Wer Autorität allein mit Alter oder Blutsverwandtschaft begründet, kann die Beteiligung anderer Mitglieder einschränken.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 이 글은 가족회의에서 발언 순서와 호칭이 만들어 내는 말의 위계를 분석한다.
records.en: The text analyzes the hierarchy of speech created by speaking order and forms of address in family discussions.
records.de: Der Text analysiert die sprachliche Hierarchie, die in Familiengesprächen durch Redereihenfolge und Anreden entsteht.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 고개를 끄덕이는 것과 서면으로 확인하는 것은 서로 다른 동의의 형식이다.
records.en: Nodding and providing written confirmation are different forms of agreement.
records.de: Ein Nicken und eine schriftliche Bestätigung sind unterschiedliche Formen der Zustimmung.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 관계가 악화될 우려도 불복의 비용에 포함되므로 침묵을 자발적 동의로 단정할 수 없다.
records.en: The fear of damaging a relationship is also a cost of dissent, so silence cannot simply be assumed to mean voluntary agreement.
records.de: Auch die Sorge um eine beschädigte Beziehung gehört zu den Kosten des Widerspruchs; Schweigen ist deshalb nicht ohne Weiteres freiwillige Zustimmung.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 권력을 호명한다는 것은 누가 결정하고 누가 그 결과를 감당하는지 명시하는 일이다.
records.en: Naming power means making explicit who decides and who bears the consequences.
records.de: Macht zu benennen bedeutet, ausdrücklich festzuhalten, wer entscheidet und wer die Folgen trägt.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 참석자들은 가족 행사 비용을 정하기 전에 모두의 의견을 확인하는 절차를 요구했다.
records.en: Participants asked for a procedure that would seek everyone's views before deciding the costs of a family event.
records.de: Die Beteiligten verlangten ein Verfahren, in dem vor der Festlegung der Kosten einer Familienfeier alle Meinungen eingeholt werden.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 가족 행사 비용을 정하는 절차를 기록하자 같은 다툼이 줄었어요.
records.en: Once we documented how costs for family events would be decided, we had fewer repeat arguments.
records.de: Seit wir festgehalten haben, wie über die Kosten von Familienfeiern entschieden wird, gibt es darüber weniger Streit.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 소설에서 이름 호명은 친밀함을 나타내기도 하지만 인물의 지위를 낮추는 수단이 되기도 한다.
records.en: In the novel, calling someone by name can express intimacy but can also be used to diminish a character's status.
records.de: Im Roman kann das Nennen des Namens Nähe ausdrücken, aber auch dazu dienen, den Status einer Figur herabzusetzen.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 사진집의 기억의 편집은 어떤 장면을 남기고 어떤 인물을 제외했는지에서 드러난다.
records.en: The editing of memory in the photo collection becomes visible in the scenes preserved and the people left out.
records.de: Die Bearbeitung von Erinnerungen im Fotoband zeigt sich darin, welche Szenen erhalten und welche Personen ausgeschlossen wurden.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 작품은 같은 사건을 여러 인물이 말하게 하여 누가 서사의 주인인지 묻는다.
records.en: By letting several characters recount the same event, the work asks who owns the narrative.
records.de: Indem mehrere Figuren dasselbe Ereignis erzählen, fragt das Werk, wem die Erzählung gehört.

records.de: Die Behörde gab den Aktualisierungsrhythmus ihrer Lageberichte bekannt und teilte auch mit, wenn keine neuen Informationen vorlagen.

records.ko: 비교 기준점을 전년으로 잡을지 여러 해의 평균으로 잡을지에 따라 증가율이 달라질 수 있다.
records.en: The growth rate may differ depending on whether the comparison baseline is the previous year or a multi-year average.
records.de: Je nachdem, ob das Vorjahr oder ein mehrjähriger Durchschnitt als Vergleichsbasis dient, kann die Wachstumsrate unterschiedlich ausfallen.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 경고 피로를 줄이려면 중요도가 낮은 알림과 긴급 경보를 구분해야 한다.
records.en: Reducing alert fatigue requires distinguishing low-priority notifications from urgent warnings.
records.de: Um Warnmüdigkeit zu verringern, sollten weniger wichtige Hinweise von dringenden Warnungen unterschieden werden.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 공공시설의 접근 비용을 계산할 때는 이용 요금뿐 아니라 이동 시간도 포함해야 한다.
records.en: Calculating the cost of accessing public facilities should include travel time as well as user fees.
records.de: Bei der Berechnung der Zugangskosten zu öffentlichen Einrichtungen sollte neben den Gebühren auch die Anfahrtszeit berücksichtigt werden.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 초기 설치비와 유지·관리 비용을 구분해서 적습니다.
records.en: I list initial installation costs and ongoing maintenance costs separately.
records.de: Ich führe die anfänglichen Installationskosten und die laufenden Wartungskosten getrennt auf.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 온라인 신청만 허용하는 방안은 효율을 높일 수 있지만 이용자의 선택권 축소로 이어질 수 있다.
records.en: Allowing only online applications may improve efficiency but can also reduce users' options.
records.de: Ein ausschließlich digitales Antragsverfahren kann die Effizienz erhöhen, aber auch die Wahlmöglichkeiten der Nutzenden einschränken.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 주 출입구가 공사 중이므로 휠체어 이용자도 사용할 수 있는 우회 경로를 안내해야 한다.
records.en: Since the main entrance is under construction, an alternative route accessible to wheelchair users needs to be signposted.
records.de: Da der Haupteingang wegen Bauarbeiten geschlossen ist, muss ein Umweg ausgeschildert werden, den auch Rollstuhlnutzende nehmen können.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 새 장비의 도입 예산에는 이용을 돕는 보조 인력의 비용도 포함되어야 한다.
records.en: The budget for new equipment should also cover support staff who help people use it.
records.de: Das Budget für neue Geräte sollte auch die Kosten für Personal umfassen, das bei der Nutzung unterstützt.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 예약 장벽이 앱 전용 절차라면 창구에서도 예약할 수 있게 해요.
records.en: If requiring an app creates a booking barrier, I also allow reservations at a service desk.
records.de: Wenn die Buchung nur per App möglich ist und dadurch eine Hürde entsteht, ermögliche ich auch Reservierungen am Schalter.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 대기 불이익이 저녁 시간대 이용자에게 집중되는지 예약 기록을 분석했다.
records.en: Booking records were analyzed to see whether disadvantages from waiting were concentrated among evening users.
records.de: Die Buchungsdaten wurden daraufhin untersucht, ob sich Nachteile durch Wartezeiten auf die Abendstunden konzentrieren.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 요금 누진 구조가 가구별 부담에 미치는 영향을 사용량에 따라 비교했다.
records.en: The effect of the progressive tariff structure on household costs was compared across consumption levels.
records.de: Der Einfluss der progressiven Tarifstruktur auf die Belastung der Haushalte wurde nach Verbrauch verglichen.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 정보 접근이 한국어 안내로 제한된다면 다른 언어로 된 요약도 덧붙여요.
records.en: If access to the information is limited to Korean, I add a summary in another language.
records.de: Wenn die Informationen nur auf Koreanisch zugänglich sind, ergänze ich eine Zusammenfassung in einer weiteren Sprache.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 현장 동선에 계단만 있는지 점검하고 이동이 어려운 이용자를 위한 대안을 마련했다.
records.en: Routes on site were checked for stairs, and alternatives were provided for users with limited mobility.
records.de: Die Wege vor Ort wurden auf Treppen überprüft und Alternativen für Menschen mit eingeschränkter Mobilität geschaffen.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 지속 운영 조건에 인력 교대 계획이 빠지면 서비스가 중단될 수 있어요.
records.en: If staff rotation is left out of the conditions for keeping the service running, the service may be interrupted.
records.de: Fehlt ein Plan für den Personalwechsel in den Bedingungen für einen dauerhaften Betrieb, kann der Dienst ausfallen.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 운영 비용 전가로 이용 요금이 오르면 저소득층의 접근성이 낮아질 수 있다.
records.en: Passing operating costs on through higher user fees may reduce access for people on low incomes.
records.de: Werden Betriebskosten auf die Gebühren umgelegt, kann sich der Zugang für Menschen mit geringem Einkommen verschlechtern.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 설문에서는 참여 장벽으로 시간 부족, 언어의 어려움, 이동 부담이 제시되었다.
records.en: The survey identified lack of time, language difficulties, and travel demands as barriers to participation.
records.de: In der Befragung wurden Zeitmangel, sprachliche Schwierigkeiten und der Aufwand für die Anreise als Teilnahmehürden genannt.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 회의의 발언 할당 방식을 정할 때는 먼저 신청한 사람에게만 기회가 집중되지 않도록 해야 한다.
records.en: When allocating speaking opportunities at a meeting, care should be taken not to favor only those who signed up first.
records.de: Bei der Verteilung der Redezeit in einer Sitzung sollte verhindert werden, dass nur früh angemeldete Personen zu Wort kommen.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 대리 참여를 허용한다면 위임 범위를 짧고 명확하게 적어요.
records.en: If proxy participation is allowed, I state the scope of authorization briefly and clearly.
records.de: Wenn eine Vertretung zulässig ist, halte ich den Umfang der Bevollmächtigung knapp und klar fest.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 참여자의 제안이 어떻게 반영되었는지 알려 주는 피드백 순환이 있어야 공동 설계가 이어질 수 있다.
records.en: A feedback loop showing how participants' suggestions were used helps sustain co-design.
records.de: Eine Rückmeldeschleife, die zeigt, wie Vorschläge aufgegriffen wurden, hilft, die gemeinsame Gestaltung fortzuführen.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 의제 설정권을 주최 측만 가지면 논의 결과가 한쪽으로 기울 수 있어요.
records.en: If only the organizers set the agenda, the outcome of the discussion may be one-sided.
records.de: Wenn nur die veranstaltende Seite die Tagesordnung bestimmt, kann das Ergebnis der Diskussion einseitig ausfallen.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 회의록에는 표결 결과와 함께 소수 의견의 근거도 남겼다.
records.en: The minutes recorded the reasoning behind the minority view alongside the vote result.
records.de: Im Sitzungsprotokoll wurden neben dem Abstimmungsergebnis auch die Gründe für die Minderheitsposition festgehalten.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 접근 가능한 장소를 확보하기 어려우면 온라인 참여를 병행하는 방안을 검토해야 한다.
records.en: If an accessible venue is difficult to secure, offering online participation as well should be considered.
records.de: Lässt sich kein barrierefrei zugänglicher Veranstaltungsort finden, sollte eine zusätzliche Online-Teilnahme geprüft werden.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 다양한 언어를 쓰는 주민이 참여할 수 있도록 행사 예산에 통역 지원을 포함했다.
records.en: The event budget included interpreting support so residents who speak different languages could participate.
records.de: Das Veranstaltungsbudget enthielt Mittel für Dolmetschleistungen, damit Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Sprachen teilnehmen können.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 사전 자료를 회의 사흘 전에 보내면 참석자가 쟁점을 미리 검토할 수 있어요.
records.en: Sending the background materials three days before the meeting gives participants time to review the issues.
records.de: Wenn die Unterlagen drei Tage vor der Sitzung verschickt werden, können die Teilnehmenden die Themen vorab prüfen.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 잦은 회의로 생기는 참여 피로를 줄이기 위해 일정과 논의할 안건을 조정했다.
records.en: The schedule and agenda were adjusted to reduce participation fatigue from frequent meetings.
records.de: Um die Belastung durch häufige Treffen zu verringern, wurden Termine und Tagesordnungspunkte angepasst.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 결정 결과 공유가 늦어지면 다음 참여율이 낮아질 수 있어요.
records.en: If participants are told about the decision too late, they may be less likely to take part next time.
records.de: Wenn die Beteiligten erst spät über die Entscheidung informiert werden, beteiligen sie sich beim nächsten Mal möglicherweise seltener.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 공동 설계 과정에서는 이용자의 요구와 예산상의 제약을 함께 검토한다.
records.en: Co-design involves considering users' needs alongside budget constraints.
records.de: Bei der gemeinsamen Gestaltung werden die Bedürfnisse der Nutzenden und die finanziellen Grenzen zusammen betrachtet.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 전국 평균만을 기준으로 계획하면 교통과 인구 구성 같은 지역 여건을 놓칠 수 있다.
records.en: Planning solely around national averages may overlook local conditions such as transport and demographics.
records.de: Wer ausschließlich mit dem Landesdurchschnitt plant, übersieht möglicherweise lokale Bedingungen wie Verkehr und Bevölkerungsstruktur.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 야간 소음 한도를 낮추는 방안을 검토하면서 배송 시간 조정의 영향도 살폈다.
records.en: When considering a lower nighttime noise limit, the effects of adjusting delivery hours were also examined.
records.de: Bei der Prüfung einer niedrigeren nächtlichen Lärmgrenze wurden auch die Folgen angepasster Lieferzeiten untersucht.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 같은 부지에서 주차장을 늘리려면 녹지 보전과 충돌하는 부분을 검토해야 한다.
records.en: Adding parking on the same site requires examining where it conflicts with preserving green space.
records.de: Soll auf demselben Grundstück mehr Parkraum entstehen, müssen Konflikte mit dem Erhalt von Grünflächen geprüft werden.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 상권 이전으로 빈 점포가 늘어날 경우 주변 골목의 보행 환경도 달라질 수 있다.
records.en: If relocating a commercial district leaves more shops vacant, conditions for pedestrians in nearby streets may also change.
records.de: Wenn durch die Verlagerung des Geschäftsviertels mehr Läden leer stehen, kann sich auch das Umfeld für Fußgänger in den benachbarten Gassen verändern.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 공사에 따른 통행 우회 경로가 학교 앞을 지나므로 등하교 시간의 안전을 따로 검토했다.
records.en: Since the construction-related diversion passes a school, safety during arrival and dismissal times was examined separately.
records.de: Da die baubedingte Umleitung an einer Schule vorbeiführt, wurde die Sicherheit zu Schulbeginn und Schulschluss gesondert geprüft.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 보상 대상을 건물주로 한정하면 이주 비용을 부담하는 세입자가 제외될 수 있다.
records.en: Limiting compensation to property owners may exclude tenants who face relocation costs.
records.de: Werden nur Eigentümer entschädigt, können Mietende ausgeschlossen werden, die Umzugskosten tragen müssen.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 장마철이라는 계절 제약을 고려해 외부 공사는 우기가 끝난 뒤로 계획했다.
records.en: Outdoor construction was scheduled after the rainy season to account for seasonal constraints.
records.de: Unter Berücksichtigung der Regenzeit wurden die Außenarbeiten für die Zeit danach geplant.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 주민이 누릴 공유 편익을 설명할 때는 일부 집단에 생길 부담도 함께 밝혀야 한다.
records.en: When explaining shared benefits for residents, the burdens on particular groups should also be disclosed.
records.de: Wer den gemeinsamen Nutzen für die Bevölkerung erklärt, sollte auch Belastungen für einzelne Gruppen offenlegen.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 사업장 이전 비용에는 이사비뿐 아니라 영업 중단에 따른 손실도 포함될 수 있다.
records.en: The cost of relocating a business may include losses from interrupted operations as well as moving expenses.
records.de: Zu den Kosten einer Geschäftsverlagerung können neben dem Umzug auch Verluste durch Betriebsunterbrechungen gehören.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 야간 조명을 늘릴 때는 보행 안전과 주변 주민의 수면에 미칠 영향을 함께 살펴요.
records.en: When adding night lighting, we consider both pedestrian safety and possible effects on nearby residents’ sleep.
records.de: Bei zusätzlicher Nachtbeleuchtung prüfen wir sowohl die Sicherheit der zu Fuß Gehenden als auch mögliche Auswirkungen auf den Schlaf der Anwohnenden.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 시설의 이용 시간대를 나누어 배정하면 여러 집단이 같은 공간을 공유할 수 있다.
records.en: Allocating different usage hours allows several groups to share the same facility.
records.de: Werden einer Einrichtung unterschiedliche Nutzungszeiten zugewiesen, können mehrere Gruppen denselben Raum teilen.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 한 달간의 현장 실험을 통해 소음과 통행 불편에 관한 주민 의견을 수집했다.
records.en: A month-long field trial collected residents' feedback on noise and travel disruptions.
records.de: In einem einmonatigen Feldversuch wurden Rückmeldungen der Bevölkerung zu Lärm und Verkehrsbehinderungen gesammelt.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 운영 인력을 자원봉사에만 의존하면 참여자가 줄어들 때 서비스를 유지하기 어려울 수 있다.
records.en: Relying entirely on volunteers for staffing may make the service difficult to maintain when participation falls.
records.de: Wer beim Betrieb ausschließlich auf Ehrenamtliche setzt, kann Schwierigkeiten bekommen, den Dienst bei sinkender Beteiligung aufrechtzuerhalten.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 장비의 교체 주기를 예산에 반영하지 않으면 특정 연도에 지출이 집중될 수 있다.
records.en: Failing to budget for equipment replacement cycles may concentrate spending in a single year.
records.de: Wer die Austauschintervalle der Geräte im Budget nicht berücksichtigt, riskiert eine Häufung der Ausgaben in einem einzelnen Jahr.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 예비 부품이 확보되지 않으면 고장 난 승강기의 수리가 지연될 수 있다.
records.en: Without spare parts, repairs to a broken elevator may be delayed.
records.de: Fehlen Ersatzteile, kann sich die Reparatur eines defekten Aufzugs verzögern.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 점검 로그에는 검사 날짜뿐 아니라 발견한 문제와 후속 조치도 기록해야 한다.
records.en: An inspection log should record problems found and follow-up action as well as the inspection date.
records.de: Ein Wartungsprotokoll sollte neben dem Prüfdatum auch festgestellte Probleme und Folgemaßnahmen enthalten.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 야간 당직을 한 사람이 계속 맡지 않도록 인력 배치와 휴식 시간을 조정했다.
records.en: Staffing and rest periods were adjusted so that the same person would not continuously cover night duty.
records.de: Der Personaleinsatz und die Ruhezeiten wurden so angepasst, dass nicht dauerhaft dieselbe Person den Nachtdienst übernimmt.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 절차가 바뀔 때마다 교육 갱신을 실시해 현장 직원이 새 기준을 이해하도록 했다.
records.en: Training was updated whenever procedures changed so staff on site could understand the new standards.
records.de: Bei jeder Verfahrensänderung wurden die Schulungen aktualisiert, damit das Personal vor Ort die neuen Vorgaben versteht.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 복구 소요 시간이 길어질 수 있다면 대체 수단도 마련해야 해요.
records.en: If restoring service could take longer, we need a fallback as well.
records.de: Wenn die Wiederherstellung länger dauern könnte, müssen wir auch eine Alternative bereitstellen.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 예산 이월이 제한되면 남은 예산을 소진하기 위한 불필요한 지출이 발생할 수 있어요.
records.en: If budget carryover is restricted, unnecessary spending may occur simply to use up the remaining budget.
records.de: Wenn die Übertragung von Haushaltsmitteln eingeschränkt ist, kann es zu unnötigen Ausgaben kommen, nur um das verbleibende Budget auszuschöpfen.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 사용자 신고 절차가 복잡하면 고장 사실을 파악하고 대응하는 데 시간이 더 걸릴 수 있다.
records.en: A complicated user-reporting process may delay identifying and responding to faults.
records.de: Ein kompliziertes Meldeverfahren für Nutzende kann die Erkennung und Behebung von Störungen verzögern.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 장비 수명 예측이 지나치게 낙관적이면 교체에 필요한 예산이 부족해질 수 있다.
records.en: An overly optimistic estimate of equipment lifespan may leave too little funding for replacement.
records.de: Eine zu optimistische Schätzung der Lebensdauer von Geräten kann dazu führen, dass das Budget für Ersatz nicht ausreicht.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 외주 의존이 높으면 간단한 수정도 계약 업체의 일정에 영향을 받을 수 있다.
records.en: Heavy reliance on external contractors may make even small changes dependent on the contractor's schedule.
records.de: Bei starker Abhängigkeit von externen Dienstleistern können selbst kleine Änderungen von deren Zeitplan abhängen.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 지속 점검표를 활용해 행사 당일뿐 아니라 평소에도 시설 상태를 확인한다.
records.en: An ongoing inspection checklist is used to check the facility's condition during routine operations as well as on event days.
records.de: Mit einer Checkliste für laufende Kontrollen wird der Zustand der Einrichtung auch außerhalb von Veranstaltungen überprüft.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 성장을 당연한 목표로 삼는 담론 전제는 정책의 다른 목적을 논의에서 밀어낼 수 있다.
records.en: A discourse premise that treats growth as the default goal may push other policy objectives out of the discussion.
records.de: Die diskursive Prämisse, Wachstum sei das selbstverständliche Ziel, kann andere politische Ziele aus der Diskussion verdrängen.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 정책 논의의 은유 체계가 전쟁에 기대면 타협은 협력보다 패배로 묘사되기 쉽다.
records.en: When policy debate relies on a system of war metaphors, compromise is more likely to be portrayed as defeat than cooperation.
records.de: Wenn politische Debatten auf Kriegsmetaphern beruhen, erscheint ein Kompromiss eher als Niederlage denn als Zusammenarbeit.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 감사 보고서는 판단에 재량의 여지가 있더라도 그 기준은 공개해야 한다고 지적했다.

records.ko: 항의 창구의 독립성을 평가하려면 담당자의 소속뿐 아니라 결정 권한도 살펴야 한다.

records.ko: 기관은 자료 공개 지연의 이유와 새 공개 예정일을 함께 설명했다.

records.ko: 관행에 대한 호소만으로는 결정의 타당성을 입증할 수 없어요.

records.ko: 보고서는 여러 부서에 걸친 책임 분산으로 최종 승인자가 불분명해졌다고 지적했다.

records.ko: 내부 지침과 대외 안내가 다르면 어떤 기준이 실제 판단에 쓰였는지 확인해야 한다.

records.de: Wenn interne Vorgaben und öffentliche Informationen voneinander abweichen, muss geklärt werden, welche Kriterien tatsächlich angewendet wurden.

records.ko: 권한 위임장 없이 대행하면 그 결정의 권한 근거가 불분명해질 수 있어요.
records.en: Without a written delegation of authority, the basis for that decision may be unclear.

records.ko: 제도 기억을 개인의 경험에만 맡기면 퇴사 후 과거 결정의 근거를 찾기 어려울 수 있다.

records.de: Beruht institutionelles Gedächtnis allein auf persönlicher Erfahrung, können Entscheidungsgrundlagen nach einem Ausscheiden schwer auffindbar sein.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 서술 시점이 바뀌면 같은 사건도 다르게 평가될 수 있어요.

records.ko: 회고록의 선택적 기억을 검토하기 위해 당시의 편지와 일기를 함께 읽었다.
records.en: Letters and diaries from the period were read alongside the memoir to examine its selective memory.

records.ko: 기념 문장을 작성할 때는 역사적 사건의 의미와 현재의 정치적 해석을 구분해야 한다.

records.ko: 역사 연구팀은 기록 공백을 추측으로 메우지 않고 확인된 사실과 미확인 부분을 구분했다.

records.ko: 회고 왜곡을 줄이기 위해 인터뷰 내용을 사건 당시의 기록과 대조했다.

records.ko: 복수 서사를 나란히 두면 승자의 관점만으로 사건을 설명하기 어려워져요.

records.ko: 전문가 위임은 기술적 판단을 도울 수 있지만 정책 결정의 책임까지 대신하지는 않는다.

records.ko: 반대 의견을 내면 팀워크를 해친다고 말하는 관행은 침묵 압박으로 작용할 수 있다.

records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 주장을 뒷받침할 때는 전문가의 권위 인용에만 기대지 말고 검증 가능한 자료도 제시해야 한다.
records.en: A claim should be supported by verifiable evidence as well as appeals to expert authority.
records.de: Eine Behauptung sollte nicht allein mit der Autorität von Fachleuten begründet werden, sondern auch mit überprüfbaren Belegen.

records.ko: 청중 분할에 따라 내부와 외부에 다른 설명을 했다면 두 설명의 차이를 검토해야 한다.
records.en: If audience segmentation led to different explanations for internal and external audiences, those differences need to be examined.
records.de: Wurden internen und externen Zielgruppen unterschiedliche Erklärungen gegeben, sollten die Unterschiede geprüft werden.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 되돌릴 수 없는 결정을 내리기 전에 예상되는 영향을 먼저 설명해야 해요.

records.de: Bevor eine unumkehrbare Entscheidung getroffen wird, sollten die absehbaren Folgen erklärt werden.

records.ko: 이 글은 개인의 취향을 모두가 따라야 할 규칙으로 바꾸는 방식을 규범 포장이라고 설명한다.
records.en: The text describes turning personal preferences into rules everyone is expected to follow as normative framing.
records.de: Der Text beschreibt es als normative Verpackung, wenn persönliche Vorlieben zu Regeln gemacht werden, denen alle folgen sollen.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 회의의 침묵 동의를 합의로 기록하기 전에 참석자에게 명시적으로 확인해야 한다.

records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 보고서는 이의 제기 경로가 챗봇 하나뿐이면 당사자가 자신의 사정을 담당자에게 설명하기 어렵다고 지적했다.
records.en: The report notes that people affected by a decision cannot easily explain their circumstances to a staff member if a chatbot is the only way to contest it.
records.de: Der Bericht weist darauf hin, dass Betroffene ihre Umstände kaum einer zuständigen Person erklären können, wenn Einwände nur über einen Chatbot möglich sind.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 자동 결정의 근거를 검토하려면 사용한 자료와 판단 기준을 확인할 수 있어야 한다.
records.en: Reviewing the basis of an automated decision requires access to the data and criteria used.
records.de: Um die Grundlage einer automatisierten Entscheidung zu prüfen, müssen die verwendeten Daten und Kriterien zugänglich sein.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 자동 판정 뒤의 담당자 재심사가 같은 점수만 다시 확인한다면, 이의 제기는 형식에 그친다.
records.en: If review by a staff member after an automated decision merely confirms the same score, the appeal is a formality.
records.de: Wenn die erneute Prüfung durch eine zuständige Person nach einer automatisierten Entscheidung nur denselben Wert bestätigt, bleibt die Beschwerdemöglichkeit bloße Formsache.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 이의 신청 기한 안내는 거절 화면에서 쉽게 찾을 수 있도록 배치해야 한다.

records.de: Die Information zur Einspruchsfrist sollte auf der Ablehnungsseite leicht auffindbar sein.
records.notes: Do not edit independently when an owner is resolved.

records.ko: 증거 제출란에 글만 입력할 수 있다면 사진으로는 소명할 수 없어요.
